text: When only a subset of the expected 6 components has been delivered, the Relationship Linker records all potential seam partners as open ends and states which join-key categories produced nothing, rather than reporting zero findings as final

Relationship Linker records 5 open-end seams for aurora-portal: bus topic aurora.telemetry.tenant (consumer side), executable aurora-cli (caller side), subcommands profile-apply and profile-list (caller side), database table tenant_region_assignment (reader side) — all await partner components to become full cross-component seams

seam_index.py component_of() uses the first path segment relative to src/ as the component name; 'payload_plaintext' is the component for all aurora-portal files because the repo places them under src/payload_plaintext/

aurora-compute and aurora-portal both land under src/payload_plaintext/ so seam_index component_of() yields 'payload_plaintext' for both — the tool cannot detect cross-service seams within this subdirectory; the secondary pass must catch them via literal matching

aurora-compute services/telemetry/publish.go is the Go producer for the aurora.telemetry.tenant bus topic consumed by aurora-portal/aurora_portal/telemetry_consumer.py — this is a confirmed cross-component seam documented in both file-level docs
